summary: legal checked in 4 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, platform-policy, and data-handling boundaries. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private, keep external outreach unsent, authorize no rights-dependent monetization or alert expansion, and continue only bounded read-only evidence work. Evidence: official Woot materials establish API access mechanics but not rights to store, derive, cache, display, retain historical data, send alerts, use images/trademarks/prices, or monetize; public terms point against the proposed use. Fleet compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 14 fail, 10 unknown, with open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings. Security, accuracy/freshness, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed and 4 remain open. No task is closable because available evidence is partial. Open tasks are source rights; alert-data flow and retention; GA4 consent and configuration; and logs, vendors, and incident handling. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach, enable tracking, expand alerts, change the private gate, or expand monetization.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required and launch-blocked; user alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed. No item is clear or conditionally launchable on current evidence. Smallest next actions: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review; produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table; capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking; and produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory covering log fields, retention, access, incident, and data-request procedures.

Compliance and claims triage: preserve cookie and analytics disclosures, consent and withdrawal behavior, affiliate disclosures, claims substantiation, data provenance and rights, copyright and trademark boundaries, platform-policy limits, and regulated or age-sensitive safeguards where supported by site evidence. Do not infer adult or regulated status from domain names. Revenue evidence covers only 2026-09-21: $4.92 aggregate commission is not site-attributable; ROI, margin, payback, and monetization expansion are unsupported. Ordinary growth may continue only conditionally and without new tracking, monetization, claims, external sharing, or regulated-scope expansion.
